title: Record Count & Completeness
requirement: With 10,000 source orders, Bronze, Silver and Target must each contain exactly the same 10,000 order_id values. Gold aggregates by order date: reconcile total order_count, not the number of Gold rows. Equal row counts alone do not prove completeness.
learning_objectives: Explain pipeline execution success versus data quality success.
Compare counts at boundaries with the same data grain.
Confirm completeness with key-set comparison, beyond row counts.
